whoItsFor: Developers who use more than one AI coding agent, provider, or subscription account and want to switch models from one place. The README says it isn't needed if you use a single agent on its vendor's own plan.
useCases: Run Claude Code on Kimi or DeepSeek models, or Codex on DeepSeek
Fail over to another account or model when a subscription quota runs out
Pick the model for each agent from one menu bar app or CLI

requirements.runtime: Go (for go install), Docker (optional), Bun (downloaded automatically for plugins)
